author: Mark Atwood
text:
Rewritten 2026-05-13 per Mark's Option-B decision after the do-beads triage on this bead.

Original bead targeted handle_space_query and assumed the /query response carried Space objects to trim. Both assumptions were wrong: (1) handle_space_query in src/space.rs:319-325 already returns the RFC 8620 §5.5 standard ids-only shape; (2) the spec text at draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:1182 conflated /query (which returns ids) with /get (which returns objects + applies properties). The bead has been re-targeted at handle_space_get; the notFound classification for non-previewable spaces is split to JMAP-v9py.20; the spec edit that this implementation depends on is tracked by JMAP-v9py.19.

This bead is now blocked by JMAP-v9py.19. The spec prompt has been handed to a separate session against ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec; when that commit lands and Mark closes .19, this bead becomes claimable.

Removing 'human' label — the architectural ambiguity is resolved.
